note: One REAL drawing per terrain symbol, cut from the standard's own vector source. Every register entry is rendered from the DGIWG Symbol Register SVG (SO_####.svg) with rsvg-convert, so the symbol keeps the standard's own colours on a transparent ground. The register is CC BY 2.0. The one non-register entry (quay) is the USGS public-domain vector symbol. AEE does not hand-draw and does not crop a scanned plate.
